title: Brand Name or Equal: Qgenda Scheduling Software (Sources Sought)
description: Sources Sought for Qgenda scheduling software, brand name or equal, issued by Network Contract Office 19. Information and planning only, not a solicitation. Responses limited to 8 pages, due by email Oct 23, 2026 at 15:00 MST; proprietary information should be marked. VA identified NAICS 541519 Other Computer Related Services with a $34 million size standard and asks respondents to say if a different NAICS fits better. Interested contractors submit an overview of the proposed solution and a capability or qualifications statement.
